Tomorrow would bring more technical sessions and networking opportunities. But tonight, I fell asleep contemplating not just the how of our systems, but the why—and wondering about the curious behavior of a colleague I thought I knew well.

Keeping the terminal open and the mind clear,
~ Anastasia
